resolution.note: shippedMerge fetches origin <base> once on a miss; test/hook/stop.test.ts lagging-clone case red before, green after

title: A lane whose ship merged ends even when the main checkout has not fetched the merge
body:
Why: lane t-0bct43k (merged debf26c) was refused its end after a merged ship: shippedMerge (src/hook/stop.ts:819) tests ancestry against origin/<base> and local <base> without fetching, and the main checkout refs lagged the merge.
Outcome: shippedMerge fetches origin <base> once when the sha is not yet an ancestor, then re-checks.
Proof: test/hook/stop.test.ts: a clone whose main lags origin accepts verdict: merged <sha> pushed only to origin.
